user.title: Select Device Type
user.description: Choose your device model or the connection type it uses.

samsung_2878.title: Device Details (Port 2878)
samsung_2878.description: Enter your air conditioner's information. The MAC address is optional and will be auto-detected if possible. If you don't have a token, leave it blank to start the acquisition process.

samsung_8888.title: Device Details (Port 8888)
samsung_8888.description: Enter your air conditioner's information. If you already have the token, you can enter it to skip pairing. Otherwise, leave it blank.

mim_h03.title: Device Details (MIM-H03)
mim_h03.description: Enter your MIM-H03 controller's information. If you already have the token, you can enter it to skip pairing. Otherwise, leave it blank.

rest_api.title: Device Details (REST API)
rest_api.description: Enter the details for your device. The token and device ID must be obtained manually according to your model's documentation.

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the device. Verify the data (IP/Host, Token, etc.) and that the device is online.
error.pairing_init_failed: Could not put the device in pairing mode. Verify the IP address and that the device is online.
error.auth_failed_turned_off: Authentication error (Code 301). Pairing has failed. Possible causes: the power button was not pressed in time (~20s) or the AC was already on. Make sure the AC is OFF before starting and turn it ON when prompted.
error.token_acquisition_failed: Could not get the token. Make sure you press the power button on the unit in time and that the IP is correct.
error.mac_resolve_failed: Could not get the MAC address automatically. Please enter it manually.
error.device_id_required: The device ID is required for this type of configuration.
error.port_in_use: The listening port (8888 or 8889) is already in use. Make sure there is no other active pairing process.
error.timeout_8888: Timeout. Make sure you press the 'AP' button on the device in the next 60 seconds.
error.invalid_response: The device returned an unexpected response. Pairing has failed.
error.final_validation_failed: Final validation failed. Could not connect to the device with the obtained credentials. Please restart the device and try again.

abort.already_configured: This device (same MAC address or ID) has already been configured.
abort.not_implemented: This device type is not yet implemented.

progress.awaiting_button_press: Waiting for user... Please press the power button on the air conditioning unit at **{ip_address}**. You have about 20 seconds to complete this action before the device cancels the process.
progress.awaiting_ap_button_press: Waiting for user... Please press the **physical AP button** on the indoor unit of the air conditioner at **{ip_address}**. You have about 60 seconds to complete this action.
progress.acquire_8888: Waiting for user... Please press the **AP** button on the air conditioning unit at **{ip_address}**. You have about 60 seconds to complete this action.
progress.initiating_pairing_8888: Initiating pairing with the device at **{ip_address}**. Please wait.

common.deprecated_yaml_message: The configuration of Climate IP via YAML is obsolete and has been imported into the user interface. Please remove the `climate_ip` configuration from your `configuration.yaml` file and restart Home Assistant.
